name: relay
description: Planner/builder/reviewer handoffs between Claude Code sessions, with an Obsidian inbox/outbox bridge for Claude chat and Cowork.

vaultPath.title: Obsidian vault path
vaultPath.description: Absolute path of the Obsidian vault (must contain a .obsidian folder). Relay keeps its files under <vault>/_relay/ (handoffs/, inbox/, inbox/done/, outbox/).
